parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Site: Bori Metropolis. Interpreted VES layer models, with the curve type from the survey interpretation on file for each station:

Station Maakoro-street (curve type on file: KHKH-type)
Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------

2 | 484 | 7.45 | 9.16
3 | 255 | 15.3 | 24.4
4 | 1109 | 25 | 49.4
5 | 807 | 74.2 | 124
6 | 8895 | - | -

Station Kenpoly-sec-school-field (curve type on file: KHK-type)
Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------

4 | 4386 | - | -

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------

Write one site note per station, in the order given, using exactly this template for each station:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: Maakoro-street
Curve type: KHKH-type
Aquifer depth: 9.16 - 24.4 m
Recommendation: Target the conductive layer identified between 9.16m and 24.4m. Continue drilling deeper to investigate the secondary potential in lower layers.

Station: Kenpoly-sec-school-field
Curve type: KHK-type
Aquifer depth: 11.9 - 27.1 m
Recommendation: Focus on the conductive zone at 11.9m to 27.1m. Drill to a minimum depth of 60m to ensure adequate penetration.

Station: Kor-road
Curve type: HK-type
Aquifer depth: 111 - 130 m
Recommendation: Target the conductive zone located at the base of the thick high-resistivity sequence. Drill to at least 130m.

Station: Gokana-street
Curve type: HAK-type
Aquifer depth: 1.44 - 17.4 m
Recommendation: Target the conductive interval between 1.44m and 17.4m. Ensure appropriate well screening within this range.

Station: Bank-road
Curve type: AA-type
Aquifer depth: 0 - 5.21 m
Recommendation: Target the shallowest conductive layer. If the yield is insufficient, deepen the borehole to 13.8m.

Station: Market-road
Curve type: AAA-type
Aquifer depth: 0 - 54.6 m
Recommendation: The entire sedimentary sequence is potentially water-bearing. Drill to at least 55m to intercept the full sequence.
